definitions.gloss: taking out one's anger on someone else; misdirected anger; venting frustration on an innocent party
definitions.explanation: directing anger or frustration at someone or something unrelated to the actual source of one's frustration

examples.japanese: {八|や}つ{当|あ}たり⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Don't take it out on me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{八|や}つ{当|あ}たり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I took out my work stress on my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{機嫌|きげん}が{悪|わる}い→機嫌が悪い：19531_kigengawarui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{八|や}つ{当|あ}たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has a habit of taking his bad mood out on others.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{八|やっ}つ→八つ：02979_yattsu⟧ (eight) + ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hitting) → hitting out in all eight directions
The name suggests striking out blindly in all directions.
{八|や}つ{当|あ}たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take out one's anger on someone)

RELATED WORDS:
- {当|あ}たり{散|ち}らす (to lash out at everyone)
- ⟦{逆|さか}{恨|うら}み→逆恨み：08363_sakaurami⟧ (misplaced resentment)

USAGE:
Often used with ～⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧ or ～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な when telling someone not to take their frustration out on you. Common in contexts involving work stress, relationship problems, or general bad moods.
